dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, look! I bought a lottery ticket.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈlʊk! aɪ ˈbɔːt ə ˈlɑːtəri ˈtɪkɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? Do you think you'll win?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? duː juː ˈθɪŋk juːl ˈwɪn?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Probably not. But if I won, I'd be a millionaire!
dialogue.reading: ˈprɑːbəbli ˈnɑːt. bʌt ɪf aɪ ˈwʌn, aɪd bi ə ˌmɪljəˈnɛr!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That would be nice. If I had a lot of money, I wouldn't need my part-time job.
dialogue.reading: ðæt wʊd bi ˈnaɪs. ɪf aɪ ˈhæd ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈmʌni, aɪ ˈwʊdənt ˈniːd maɪ ˌpɑːrt taɪm ˈdʒɑːb.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And I'd buy a big house by a lake for my parents.
dialogue.reading: ənd aɪd ˈbaɪ ə ˈbɪɡ ˈhaʊs baɪ ə ˈleɪk fər maɪ ˈpɛrənts.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: If I won, I'd travel around the world.
dialogue.reading: ɪf aɪ ˈwʌn, aɪd ˈtrævəl əˈraʊnd ðə ˈwɜːrld.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I'd buy some luxury bags, too!
dialogue.reading: aɪd ˈbaɪ sʌm ˈlʌkʃəri ˈbæɡz, ˈtuː!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not me. If I had a luxury bag, I'd be too scared to use it!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt miː. ɪf aɪ ˈhæd ə ˈlʌkʃəri ˈbæɡ, aɪd bi ˈtuː ˈskɛrd tə ˈjuːz ɪt!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Ha! You're right. And I'd give some money to poor families.
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! jʊr ˈraɪt. ənd aɪd ˈɡɪv sʌm ˈmʌni tə ˈpʊr ˈfæməliz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's kind. But you aren't rich yet, Emma!
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈkaɪnd. bʌt juː ˈɑːrnt ˈrɪtʃ ˈjɛt, ˈɛmə!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I know. We'll find out on the sixteenth!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. wiːl ˈfaɪnd ˈaʊt ɑːn ðə ˌsɪksˈtiːnθ!
